Full ordered distinct-frame list + committed fixtures below. NOTE on the user's 'solid black background' recollection: in THIS path it is definitively NOT black — the narration is over the gate. If the user's memory is of the original retail box (with copy protection ENFORCED and possibly a different code path) or a different scenario, that is untested here; but the engine, driven to the BANE default, renders the narration over the dungeon, confirming maze-entry-narration.json / maze-entry-sequence.json.

findings.claim: The dungeon party panel is the SAME panel renderer as MASTER OPTIONS (FUN_1b2d @ wbase 0x1b2d) and is ALREADY fully RE'd + ported. Layout: 6 slots, EVEN slots (0,2,4) -> LEFT panel window (DGROUP 0x4fba) at screen origin (8,40); ODD slots (1,3,5) -> RIGHT panel window (DGROUP 0x4fb8) at screen origin (256,40). Each slot = a 7-wide x 4-tall cell block; panelRow = (slot/2)*4. Portrait = cols 0..2 (3x3 wport tiles) blitted at x=8 (left) / x=256 (right). Portrait slot-0 Y baseline = panel row 1 = screen y=48; per-slot Y stride = 4 cell rows = 32 px (so left portraits at y=48/80/112; right mirror at x=256, same y). Name text + HP/stat bars occupy the remaining cols of each slot block. Empty slots render as the panel's cleared background (char 0x20, attr 0x03). In the captured fixture the LEFT panel content fills screen x~0..71 (the panel + its right edge at x=71) and the RIGHT panel x~248..319. The central MAZE_VIEWPORT (x=72,y=32,w=176,h=112) sits between them.

In dosbox-pure an empty ENTER passes; the asm check routine was not pinned. If the user's 'solid black' recollection is from the retail box, a code path behind a SATISFIED-with-correct-word magicword (vs the empty-bypass here) is untested.

The exact frame timing of the magicword empty-pass + the ENTERING title flash is NON-DETERMINISTIC run-to-run (the empty-answer accept fires on a variable frame). seq-02 (title) had to be captured via a dedicated single-frame scan rather than a fixed tap+step. This does not affect the BEHAVIORAL model (3 ENTER passes, title flashes, then narration) but means a recipe-replay re-mint of seq-02 may land off-frame; treat seq-02 as a single-frame snapshot, not a deterministic recipe waypoint.

The torch/gate flicker in the MAZE_VIEWPORT (palette 5<->8 at the gate center, free-running) makes the viewport region non-deterministic across captures — same caveat as maze-corridor.state. A parity gate should region-exclude or tolerance the viewport and assert on the strip + party-panel regions.

The msg 10030-10035 'ENTRANCE CHAMBER' second narration block STILL not observed firing anywhere — consistent with maze-entry-narration.json. Likely a different scenario or a post-gate-open condition; not in the default BANE path.
tooling_notes: Used the committed NIGHTLY (unpatched) libretro core (tools/libretro/dosbox_pure_libretro.dylib) — behavioral capture only, no traceSet/regs. NO core rebuild; workspace left as found (verified git-clean).

MASTER OPTIONS navigation (CRITICAL — easy to get wrong): from EMPTY-party MASTER OPTIONS the cursor is on ADD PARTY MEMBER (top-left). To form a member: ENTER (open roster picker, cursor on first available char) -> ENTER (pick it) -> up x4 (re-anchor cursor to the top-left). Doing up x3 (as some older recipes) can drift the cursor into CHARACTER MENU on the next ENTER — use up x4 to be safe. After N adds the LEFT menu column is REVIEW MEMBER / DISMISS MEMBER / START NEW GAME / CHARACTER MENU with the cursor on REVIEW MEMBER, so START NEW GAME = down, down, ENTER.

game_state (DGROUP 0x363a via anchor()+read) reads 0xffff (65535) during MASTER OPTIONS / magicword / ENTERING title — it is only a valid small value (5) once the dungeon loads. Do NOT rely on it to detect menu sub-states; use framebuffer digests there.

Capture is STATE-DRIVEN (poll game_state==5 and party_gy at 0x4fa2) because the magicword empty-pass frame timing is non-deterministic; blind tap+step counts slip the whole downstream sequence by a frame or more. capture-newgame-fixtures.ts encapsulates the reproducible drive.
DGROUP party-field offsets (anchor()-relative): facing 0x4f9a, z 0x4f9c, cellA 0x4f9e, cellB 0x4fa0, gy 0x4fa2, gx 0x4fa4 (matches maze-entry-sequence.json).
